info.name: Mixmax REST Contact Groups Meetings API

items.docs: Search and retrieve meeting summaries with optional filters. Returns summaries for meetings where the authenticated user is the owner, or if workspace-wide access is enabled via admin settings, workspace admins can access summaries from all workspace members' meetings. Requires the mixmaxApi feature (API access enabled for your workspace).
Retrieve the full transcript for a specific meeting by its summary ID. Returns the complete transcript with speaker identification and timestamps. Requires the mixmaxApi feature.
